title: File:NanningTianchiShanPharmacy.jpg
desc: A Jian Zhi Jia (健之佳) pharmacy near the Tianchi Shan community in the Qingxiu district of Nanning, Guangxi, China. The prescription section is shown, with prepackaged Western and Chinese medicine on the shelves on the left and Chinese medicinal herbs on the shelves on the right.

title: File:A swedish pharmacy in 1911.jpg
desc:
A woman with a headscarf around her head is standing at a pharmacy counter with a medicine bottle in her hand. Behind the counter is a mustachioed man in a suit. Next to the woman stands a boy with outerwear. In the background you see medicine bottles on shelves and another pharmacy assistant.
